newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP not to close Newcastle plant.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP not to close Newcastle plant.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Tuesday it did not plan to close its Newcastle steel plant.
"We are not going to close the Newcastle plant," BHP Chairman Brian Loton told BHP's annual meeting.
"We are studying options and opportunities in regards to our steel facilities there," he said.
He said there would be a meeting soon with workers to discuss any changes and no decision would be made before then.

The troubled steel unit's net profit for the first quarter was A$90 million, falling from A$146 million a year ago on lower export prices and lower Australian domestic despatches for the Flat Products and Long Products divisions.
BHP announced a 23 percent drop in first quarter group net profit on Friday. Net profit for the three months to August 31 was A$287 million, down from A$372 million a year earlier.
BHP's share price closed up 10 cents at A$15.92 on Tuesday.
